examples.en: After the courier delivered my power bank, I left a positive review because the packaging was excellent.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的充电宝送到后，我因为包装很好而给了好评。

examples.en: The seller asked me to scan the QR code and leave a positive review after signing for delivery.
examples.zh: 卖家让我签收后扫描二维码并给个好评。

entries.shortAnswer: positive review 的中文意思是好评。它强调对商品或服务的正面评价，通常以文字或评分形式出现，反义为 negative review。
entries.definition: positive review 指对产品、服务或商家的正面评价。常见搭配：leave/post/write a positive review，收到好评可用 get/receive positive reviews。注意 review 指具体评论，rating 侧重量化评分。

examples.en: After the courier delivered my power bank, I left a positive review because the packaging was excellent.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的充电宝送到后，我因为包装很好而给了好评。

examples.en: The seller asked me to scan the QR code and leave a positive review after signing for delivery.
examples.zh: 卖家让我签收后扫描二维码并给个好评。

entries.shortAnswer: 「售后」的英文是 after-sales service，指商品售出后的维修、退换等支持。注意与「保修」warranty 区分：保修常指免费维修期限，售后则涵盖更广的服务。
entries.definition: after-sales service 是固定搭配，作名词用，常见于手机、家电、快递等行业。口语中也可说 after-sales support。搭配：provide/good after-sales service。注意不要漏掉连字符和复数 s。

examples.en: The phone comes with a one-year warranty and free after-sales service.
examples.zh: 这款手机附带一年保修和免费售后服务。

examples.en: If you have any problems with the delivery, please contact our after-sales service.
examples.zh: 如果快递有任何问题，请联系我们的售后服务。

entries.shortAnswer: After-sales service 的中文意思是「售后」，即商品售出后提供的维修、退换、咨询等服务。它比 warranty（保修）范围更广，warranty 通常只指免费维修的承诺。
entries.definition: after-sales service 是正式商务用语，指售后支持，常见搭配有 offer/provide after-sales service。口语中也可用 after-sales support。注意拼写：after-sales 带连字符，service 可作不可数名词。

examples.en: The phone comes with a one-year warranty and free after-sales service.
examples.zh: 这款手机附带一年保修和免费售后服务。

examples.en: If you have any problems with the delivery, please contact our after-sales service.
examples.zh: 如果快递有任何问题，请联系我们的售后服务。

entries.shortAnswer: 「签收」即 sign for delivery，指快递送达时签字确认收货，强调签字动作而非仅收到包裹。
entries.definition: sign for delivery 指收件人在快递或挂号信送达时签字确认，常见搭配有 refuse to sign for delivery（拒签）。

examples.en: The courier asked me to sign for delivery at the door.
examples.zh: 快递员让我在门口签收。

examples.en: If nobody can sign for delivery, the package will be sent back.
examples.zh: 如果没人能签收，包裹就会被退回。

entries.shortAnswer: Sign for delivery means 签收: signing to confirm you received a package, not just receiving it.
entries.definition: Sign for delivery is used when a courier hands you a parcel and you sign to confirm receipt, as in someone must sign for delivery.

examples.en: The courier asked me to sign for delivery at the door.
examples.zh: 快递员让我在门口签收。

examples.en: If nobody can sign for delivery, the package will be sent back.
examples.zh: 如果没人能签收，包裹就会被退回。

entries.shortAnswer: 「信号」的英文是 signal，指手机信号、Wi-Fi 信号或传递信息的信号。注意别用 sign（标志牌）或 symbol（符号）来表达手机信号。
entries.definition: 手机信号说 cell signal、signal strength 或 no signal；也常与 receive、lose、bad、weak 搭配。寄快递时「收到信号」不用 signal，而是收到短信通知。与 sign（标牌、签名）、symbol（象征符号）区分使用。

examples.en: I can't get a signal in the elevator, so I'll call you back later.
examples.zh: 电梯里没信号，我晚点再打给你。

examples.en: The courier will send you a signal by text when your package is delivered.
examples.zh: 快递员会在包裹送达时发短信通知你。

entries.shortAnswer: signal 的中文意思是「信号」，指手机、Wi-Fi 或通信中传递的信息。它比 sign（标志牌、签名）更强调传递消息的动作与载体。
entries.definition: signal 作名词指手机信号、通信信号或暗示；作动词指发信号、示意。常见搭配有 signal strength、lose signal、send a signal。注意 sign 是看得见的标志或签名，symbol 是象征符号，不要混用。

examples.en: I can't get a signal in the elevator, so I'll call you back later.
examples.zh: 电梯里没信号，我晚点再打给你。

examples.en: The courier will send you a signal by text when your package is delivered.
examples.zh: 快递员会在包裹送达时发短信通知你。

entries.shortAnswer: 「客服」的英文是 customer service，指企业为顾客提供的咨询、投诉等服务。
entries.definition: customer service 指客服部门或人员，常见搭配有 contact customer service、customer service hotline。

examples.en: If your package hasn't arrived, please contact customer service for a tracking update.
examples.zh: 如果您的包裹还没到，请联系客服获取物流更新。

examples.en: The customer service team helped me sign for delivery after I lost my pickup code.
examples.zh: 在我弄丢取件码后，客服团队帮我完成了签收。

entries.shortAnswer: Customer service means 客服, the help a company gives customers with questions or problems.
entries.definition: Customer service is the help a company offers customers, as in call customer service or customer service hotline.

examples.en: If your package hasn't arrived, please contact customer service for a tracking update.
examples.zh: 如果您的包裹还没到，请联系客服获取物流更新。

examples.en: The customer service team helped me sign for delivery after I lost my pickup code.
examples.zh: 在我弄丢取件码后，客服团队帮我完成了签收。

entries.shortAnswer: 「保修」的英文是 warranty，指厂商对产品维修或更换的承诺，注意与售后维修服务区分。
entries.definition: warranty 是可数名词，常说 under warranty（在保修期内）、extend the warranty（延保）、void the warranty（保修失效）。手机常见 one-year warranty。

examples.en: My phone is still under warranty, so the repair won't cost me anything.
examples.zh: 我的手机还在保修期内，所以维修不用花钱。

examples.en: Keep your receipt, or the warranty will be void.
examples.zh: 保留好收据，否则保修会失效。

entries.shortAnswer: warranty 的中文意思是「保修」，指厂商承诺免费维修或更换产品，比 guarantee 更常用于正式条款。
entries.definition: warranty 作名词，常见搭配为 under warranty、warranty period、extended warranty。多用于手机、电器；口语也说 it's still under warranty。

examples.en: My phone is still under warranty, so the repair won't cost me anything.
examples.zh: 我的手机还在保修期内，所以维修不用花钱。

examples.en: Keep your receipt, or the warranty will be void.
examples.zh: 保留好收据，否则保修会失效。

entries.shortAnswer: 「重启」的英文动词是 reboot，如重启手机就是 reboot your phone。注意 reboot 指系统级重新启动，而 restart 更泛用于程序或服务。
entries.definition: reboot 专指设备或系统重新启动，常见搭配：reboot the phone / system / router。名词用法 a reboot 可指重启操作或重启过程。注意与 restart 区别：重启手机用 reboot 更地道，重启应用可用 restart。

examples.en: If your phone keeps freezing, try to reboot it by holding the power button.
examples.zh: 如果你的手机一直卡死，试着按住电源键重启它。

examples.en: The courier's scanner needed a reboot before it could scan the QR code on the package.
examples.zh: 快递员的扫描仪需要重启一下，才能扫描包裹上的二维码。

entries.shortAnswer: 「reboot」的中文意思是「重启」，特指设备或系统重新启动，比如重启手机。它比 restart 更强调系统级重载。
entries.definition: reboot 作动词指重新启动计算机、手机等设备，也作名词。常见搭配：reboot the system, a full reboot。正式与口语均可用，但日常说重启手机多用 reboot，重启应用多用 restart。

examples.en: If your phone keeps freezing, try to reboot it by holding the power button.
examples.zh: 如果你的手机一直卡死，试着按住电源键重启它。

examples.en: The courier's scanner needed a reboot before it could scan the QR code on the package.
examples.zh: 快递员的扫描仪需要重启一下，才能扫描包裹上的二维码。

entries.shortAnswer: 截屏用英语说就是screenshot，既是名词也是动词。注意与截取整个屏幕的screen capture区分，screenshot更常用于手机或电脑上快速保存当前画面。
entries.definition: screenshot作名词指屏幕截图，作动词直接说screenshot the page；常见搭配take a screenshot。注意它不用于指屏幕录制（screen recording）或快递里的拍照签收（photo proof of delivery）。

examples.en: Can you send me a screenshot of the pickup code so I can collect the package?
examples.zh: 你能把取件码截屏发给我吗？我好去取快递。

examples.en: I took a screenshot of the warranty page in case I need after-sales service later.
examples.zh: 我把保修页面截屏了，以防之后需要售后服务。

entries.shortAnswer: Screenshot的中文意思是截屏，指保存当前屏幕画面的图片。与screen capture含义接近，但screenshot更强调用户主动用设备快捷键或应用功能截取的图像。
entries.definition: screenshot是名词兼动词，常见搭配take a screenshot、send a screenshot。日常口语和书面语都常用，电脑和手机皆可。易错点：别与screen recording（录屏）或screen capture（较为技术化）混用。

examples.en: Can you send me a screenshot of the pickup code so I can collect the package?
examples.zh: 你能把取件码截屏发给我吗？我好去取快递。

examples.en: I took a screenshot of the warranty page in case I need after-sales service later.
examples.zh: 我把保修页面截屏了，以防之后需要售后服务。

entries.shortAnswer: 「耳机」英文是 earphones，指塞入耳道或挂耳的小型听音设备；头戴式耳机则说 headphones。
entries.definition: earphones 是复数名词，常说 a pair of earphones、wireless earphones，搭配 listen with earphones、use earphones on the phone。口语也常用 earbuds。

examples.en: I always carry a pair of earphones in my bag so I can listen to music on the subway.
examples.zh: 我包里总会带一副耳机，这样就能在地铁上听音乐。

examples.en: She took out her earphones and started a video call with her friend.
examples.zh: 她拿出耳机，开始和朋友视频通话。

entries.shortAnswer: earphones 的中文意思是「耳机」，通常指小巧的入耳式或耳塞式设备，强调便携与贴近耳廓。
entries.definition: earphones is a plural noun: a pair of earphones, wireless earphones, use earphones with your phone. For over-ear devices, say headphones.

examples.en: I always carry a pair of earphones in my bag so I can listen to music on the subway.
examples.zh: 我包里总会带一副耳机，这样就能在地铁上听音乐。

examples.en: She took out her earphones and started a video call with her friend.
examples.zh: 她拿出耳机，开始和朋友视频通话。

entries.shortAnswer: “死机”的英文是 freeze up，常指手机、电脑等设备突然卡住、无法操作。注意 freeze up 多强调完全无响应，而 lag 只是暂时卡顿。
entries.definition: freeze up 常用于科技口语，主语是设备，如 my phone froze up。若指电脑也可说 crash，但 crash 更强调程序崩溃或系统宕机，freeze up 更侧重画面卡死、触屏无反应。

examples.en: My phone froze up while I was scanning the QR code to pick up my express delivery.
examples.zh: 我在扫二维码取快递的时候，手机突然死机了。

examples.en: If your device freezes up again, try turning it off and on before contacting after-sales service.
examples.zh: 如果你的设备再次死机，联系售后之前先试着关机再开机。

entries.shortAnswer: “freeze up”的中文意思是“死机”，指设备突然卡住、完全无法操作。它和 lag 不同，lag 是暂时卡顿，freeze up 是彻底无响应。
entries.definition: freeze up 多用于口语和非正式场合，主语常为 phone、computer、screen 等。常见搭配：my phone froze up、the screen freezes up。注意别与“冻僵”义混淆，科技语境中才指死机。

examples.en: My phone froze up while I was scanning the QR code to pick up my express delivery.
examples.zh: 我在扫二维码取快递的时候，手机突然死机了。

examples.en: If your device freezes up again, try turning it off and on before contacting after-sales service.
examples.zh: 如果你的设备再次死机，联系售后之前先试着关机再开机。

entries.shortAnswer: 「考试」的英文是 exam，多指学校里的正式考试。口语中也常用 test，但 exam 更强调重要的大考。
entries.definition: exam 是 examination 的缩写，常指期中、期末等正式考试。常见搭配：take an exam 参加考试，fail an exam 挂科，make-up exam 补考，final exam 期末考试。

examples.en: I have to study hard for my final exam next week.
examples.zh: 我得为下周的期末考试努力学习。

examples.en: If you fail the exam, you can take a make-up exam later.
examples.zh: 如果你考试不及格，之后可以参加补考。

entries.shortAnswer: Exam 的中文意思是「考试」，通常指学校里的正式考试。它和 test 意思相近，但 exam 往往更正式、更重要。
entries.definition: exam 指学校或机构组织的正式考试，如 final exam（期末考试）、entrance exam（入学考试）。口语中可指任何测验，但比 quiz 正式，比 test 更强调大考。

examples.en: I have to study hard for my final exam next week.
examples.zh: 我得为下周的期末考试努力学习。

examples.en: If you fail the exam, you can take a make-up exam later.
examples.zh: 如果你考试不及格，之后可以参加补考。

entries.shortAnswer: 「下课」的英文是 class is over，指一节课结束。注意 class is over 是句子，不是名词；表示「下课时间」常说 break 或 time for a break。
entries.definition: class is over 用于宣布某节课结束，也可说 the class is over；与之相对的是 class begins/starts。若想说「下课了，我们走吧」，用 Class is over. Let's go. 不要生造 class over 作名词。

examples.en: Class is over, so let's go grab lunch before the next lecture.
examples.zh: 下课了，我们去吃午饭吧，下节课之前还有时间。

examples.en: As soon as class is over, I need to rush to the library to return these books.
examples.zh: 一下课我就得赶去图书馆还这些书。

entries.shortAnswer: Class is over 的中文意思是「下课」，表示一节课结束。它强调课程结束的状态，而 dismiss class 强调老师宣布下课、让学生离开。
entries.definition: class is over 是常用表达，指一节课已经结束，多用于口语和校园场景。同类说法有 the class is finished/done；正式通知也可说 The class has been dismissed。注意不要说 Class is over 后接名词。

examples.en: Class is over, so let's go grab lunch before the next lecture.
examples.zh: 下课了，我们去吃午饭吧，下节课之前还有时间。

examples.en: As soon as class is over, I need to rush to the library to return these books.
examples.zh: 一下课我就得赶去图书馆还这些书。

entries.shortAnswer: 开学的英文是 school starts，也可以说 school begins。注意 school starts 强调“学校开始上课”，不指学生个人去学校报到。
entries.definition: school starts 用于描述新学期或新学年开始，常见搭配有 when school starts、before school starts。口语中也可说 school begins，但 school starts 更常用。

examples.en: School starts on September 1st, so we need to buy our textbooks now.
examples.zh: 9月1日开学，所以我们现在需要买课本了。

examples.en: When school starts, I usually get up at six thirty.
examples.zh: 开学的时候，我通常六点半起床。

entries.shortAnswer: school starts 的中文意思是开学，指学校开始上课。它和 school begins 意思相近，但 school starts 更口语化、更常用。
entries.definition: school starts 表示学校开学、开始上课，常用于描述学期或学年开始。搭配有 when school starts、school starts in September。注意不是“去学校报到”。

examples.en: School starts on September 1st, so we need to buy our textbooks now.
examples.zh: 9月1日开学，所以我们现在需要买课本了。

examples.en: When school starts, I usually get up at six thirty.
examples.zh: 开学的时候，我通常六点半起床。

entries.shortAnswer: 在手机与快递场景里，「删除」通常说 delete，比如删除取件码短信或旧地址；彻底移除数据。
entries.definition: delete 指把短信、地址或订单等信息从手机或账号中移除，常搭配 delete the message、delete my address。

examples.en: Please delete the old pickup code message after you collect your parcel.
examples.zh: 取完快递后，请把旧的取件码短信删除。

examples.en: I had to delete my previous delivery address before adding the new one.
examples.zh: 添加新地址前，我不得不先把之前的收货地址删除。

entries.shortAnswer: delete 在中文里就是「删除」，多用于手机与快递场景，如删除取件短信或旧地址，强调彻底移除数据。
entries.definition: delete means to remove a message, address, or order from your phone or account; patterns include delete the message.

examples.en: Please delete the old pickup code message after you collect your parcel.
examples.zh: 取完快递后，请把旧的取件码短信删除。

examples.en: I had to delete my previous delivery address before adding the new one.
examples.zh: 添加新地址前，我不得不先把之前的收货地址删除。

entries.shortAnswer: 「上课」的英文常用 attend class 表示，指出席课堂、去听课，较为正式。
entries.definition: attend class 是正式说法，指出席课堂、去听课；口语中更常说 go to class 或 have class。

examples.en: Students who attend class regularly are less likely to fail an exam.
examples.zh: 按时上课的学生更不容易挂科。

examples.en: If you skip class too often, the teacher may notice during roll call and mark you absent.
examples.zh: 如果你逃课太多，老师可能会在点名时注意到并记你缺勤。

entries.shortAnswer: 「attend class」的中文意思是「上课」，指出席课堂、去听课，属正式表达。
entries.definition: attend class 意为“上课、出席课堂”，常见搭配 attend class regularly，多用于正式或学术场合。

examples.en: Students who attend class regularly are less likely to fail an exam.
examples.zh: 按时上课的学生更不容易挂科。

examples.en: If you skip class too often, the teacher may notice during roll call and mark you absent.
examples.zh: 如果你逃课太多，老师可能会在点名时注意到并记你缺勤。

entries.shortAnswer: 作业的英文是 homework，指老师布置的课外学习任务，不可数，不能说 a homework。
entries.definition: homework 指学生回家完成的练习或预习，常搭配 do homework、hand in homework；不可数，表示“一份作业”用 a piece of homework。

examples.en: I have to finish my math homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 我得在晚饭前完成数学作业。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a lot of homework over the weekend.
examples.zh: 老师周末给我们布置了很多作业。

entries.shortAnswer: Homework 的中文意思是作业，指老师让学生在课外完成的学习任务，通常不可数，与课堂练习 classwork 相对。
entries.definition: homework 是名词，指家庭作业或课外准备，常搭配 do homework、finish homework；美式英语中 assignment 可指具体一项作业。

examples.en: I have to finish my math homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 我得在晚饭前完成数学作业。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a lot of homework over the weekend.
examples.zh: 老师周末给我们布置了很多作业。

entries.shortAnswer: 「毕业」的英文是 graduation，指完成学业、获授学位或文凭；常用搭配 graduation ceremony 表示毕业典礼。
entries.definition: graduation 指毕业或毕业典礼，如 graduation ceremony；不说 graduation 表示毕业证，那是 diploma。

examples.en: She plans to travel around Europe after graduation.
examples.zh: 她打算毕业后去欧洲旅行。

examples.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main hall next Friday.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼将于下周五在主礼堂举行。

entries.shortAnswer: graduation 的中文意思是「毕业」，指完成学业并获得学位或文凭；也可指毕业典礼，如 graduation ceremony。
entries.definition: graduation means 毕业 or a graduation ceremony, as in graduation ceremony. A diploma, not graduation, is the certificate.

examples.en: She plans to travel around Europe after graduation.
examples.zh: 她打算毕业后去欧洲旅行。

examples.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main hall next Friday.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼将于下周五在主礼堂举行。

entries.shortAnswer: 「同桌」的英文是 deskmate，指坐在你旁边共用一张课桌的同学。注意 deskmate 是英式拼法，美式常写作 desk mate 或 seatmate。
entries.definition: deskmate 是中性名词，小学到高中阶段最常用，大学里更常说 classmate 或 the person I sit next to。搭配动词常用 be my deskmate、sit with my deskmate。不要用 tablemate（多指饭友）。

examples.en: My deskmate always reminds me to hand in my homework on time.
examples.zh: 我的同桌总是提醒我按时交作业。

examples.en: During the self-study period, I whispered to my deskmate about the make-up exam.
examples.zh: 自习课上，我和同桌小声议论补考的事。

entries.shortAnswer: deskmate 的中文意思是「同桌」，即在同一张课桌旁与你并排坐的同学。它强调物理位置的相邻，而不只是同班关系。
entries.definition: deskmate 指班级里坐在你旁边的同学，多见于中小学语境。与 classmate 不同，classmate 只表示同班同学，不一定挨着坐；deskmate 强调共桌。口语中也可说 the person sitting next to me。

examples.en: My deskmate always reminds me to hand in my homework on time.
examples.zh: 我的同桌总是提醒我按时交作业。

examples.en: During the self-study period, I whispered to my deskmate about the make-up exam.
examples.zh: 自习课上，我和同桌小声议论补考的事。

entries.shortAnswer: 班主任的英文是 head teacher，指中小学里管理一个班级的老师；英式英语中也可指校长。
entries.definition: head teacher 指中小学的班主任，负责班级日常管理、考勤、纪律和家校沟通。英式英语中也可指校长，美式英语常用 homeroom teacher。

examples.en: Our head teacher reminded us that anyone caught skipping class would have to take a make-up exam.
examples.zh: 班主任提醒我们，凡是逃课被抓到的人都要补考。

examples.en: I asked my head teacher to write me a recommendation letter for my college application.
examples.zh: 我请班主任为我的大学申请写了一封推荐信。

entries.shortAnswer: head teacher 的中文意思是班主任，指中小学里管理一个班级的老师；英式英语中也可指校长。
entries.definition: head teacher 指中小学的班主任，负责班级日常管理、考勤、纪律和家校联系。英式英语中也可指校长，美式英语常用 homeroom teacher。

examples.en: Our head teacher reminded us that anyone caught skipping class would have to take a make-up exam.
examples.zh: 班主任提醒我们，凡是逃课被抓到的人都要补考。

examples.en: I asked my head teacher to write me a recommendation letter for my college application.
examples.zh: 我请班主任为我的大学申请写了一封推荐信。

entries.shortAnswer: 学费的英文是 tuition，特指大学或私立学校收取的教学费用，不包括书本费和住宿费。注意 tuition 在美式英语中常指学费，在英式英语中可泛指教学。
entries.definition: tuition 常与 pay、afford、cover 等动词搭配，如 pay tuition（交学费）、tuition fee（学费）。易错点：不要用 tuition 指代书本费或住宿费，这些分别是 textbook fees 和 room and board。

examples.en: Many students work part-time to pay their tuition.
examples.zh: 许多学生做兼职来支付学费。

examples.en: The university offers a tuition waiver for outstanding applicants.
examples.zh: 这所大学为优秀申请者提供学费减免。

entries.shortAnswer: Tuition 的中文意思是学费，指学校收取的教学费用，尤其用于大学。与 fee 不同，tuition 特指教学费，不包含杂费或生活费。
entries.definition: Tuition 是名词，常见搭配有 pay tuition、tuition costs、tuition waiver（学费减免）。在美式英语中常与 room and board（食宿费）并列；在英式英语中也可指教学本身。

examples.en: Many students work part-time to pay their tuition.
examples.zh: 许多学生做兼职来支付学费。

examples.en: The university offers a tuition waiver for outstanding applicants.
examples.zh: 这所大学为优秀申请者提供学费减免。

entries.shortAnswer: 「宿舍」的英文是 dormitory，日常口语也常用 dorms。英式英语里学生宿舍楼常叫 hall of residence，美式宿舍区则可能叫 residence hall。
entries.definition: Dormitory 是正式说法，指学校提供给学生住宿的楼。口语中常用简称 dorm，例如住宿舍 live in a dorm。搭配：dormitory room 宿舍房间，dormitory life 宿舍生活。

examples.en: My dormitory is just a five-minute walk from the library, so I often go there to study.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍离图书馆只有五分钟步行路程，所以我经常去那里自习。

examples.en: During the first week, the dormitory organizes orientation activities to help new students settle in.
examples.zh: 第一周，宿舍会组织迎新活动，帮助新生安顿下来。

entries.shortAnswer: Dormitory 的中文意思是「宿舍」，特指学校或机构提供给学生住宿的楼。它比 hall 更正式；口语中常简称为 dorm。
entries.definition: Dormitory 指学校、大学等提供给学生住宿的建筑物，一般有多个房间或床位。常见搭配：student dormitory、dormitory room。口语和非正式场合常用 dorm；英式英语中大学宿舍楼也称 hall of residence。

examples.en: My dormitory is just a five-minute walk from the library, so I often go there to study.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍离图书馆只有五分钟步行路程，所以我经常去那里自习。

examples.en: During the first week, the dormitory organizes orientation activities to help new students settle in.
examples.zh: 第一周，宿舍会组织迎新活动，帮助新生安顿下来。

entries.shortAnswer: 「自习」的英文是 self-study，指学生自主安排、没有老师授课的学习时间。注意：英式英语里常与 revise 搭配，美式英语则说 study on your own。
entries.definition: self-study 作名词或形容词，如 self-study period（自习课）、do self-study（自习）。不可说成 study myself，那表示「研究我自己」；若强调在教室集体自习，可说 supervised self-study。

examples.en: We have a self-study period every afternoon, so I usually review my notes in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们每天下午都有一节自习课，所以我通常在教室里复习笔记。

examples.en: If you want to improve your English, self-study is just as important as attending classes.
examples.zh: 如果你想提高英语，自习和上课同样重要。

entries.shortAnswer: self-study 的中文意思是「自习」，即学生自己安排、没有老师讲课的学习。它强调自主学习，与 revision（复习）或 homework（家庭作业）侧重点不同。
entries.definition: self-study 常与 do、time、period 搭配：do self-study、self-study time、a self-study room。口语中也可说 study by myself。注意与 self-taught 区分，后者指「自学成才」，不指在校自习。

examples.en: We have a self-study period every afternoon, so I usually review my notes in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们每天下午都有一节自习课，所以我通常在教室里复习笔记。

examples.en: If you want to improve your English, self-study is just as important as attending classes.
examples.zh: 如果你想提高英语，自习和上课同样重要。

entries.shortAnswer: 补习班在英语中常说 cram school，指为考试提分而高强度授课的课外辅导机构。
entries.definition: cram school 指以应试提分为目标的课外补习机构，常搭配 go to、attend，如 go to a cram school。cram 本义为临时抱佛脚，暗示高强度集中授课。

examples.en: After failing the math exam, he started attending a cram school every weekend to prepare for the make-up exam.
examples.zh: 数学考试挂科后，他开始每周末去补习班，为补考做准备。

examples.en: Many high school students in East Asia go to a cram school after regular classes to improve their college application chances.
examples.zh: 东亚的许多高中生放学后去补习班，以提高大学申请的成功率。

entries.shortAnswer: cram school 的中文意思是“补习班”，指为应对考试而高强度、集中授课的课外辅导机构。
entries.definition: cram school 指以备考提分为目标的辅导机构，常见搭配有 attend/go to a cram school。cram 有临时抱佛脚之意，故强调高强度、时间紧凑。

examples.en: After failing the math exam, he started attending a cram school every weekend to prepare for the make-up exam.
examples.zh: 数学考试挂科后，他开始每周末去补习班，为补考做准备。

examples.en: Many high school students in East Asia go to a cram school after regular classes to improve their college application chances.
examples.zh: 东亚的许多高中生放学后去补习班，以提高大学申请的成功率。

entries.shortAnswer: 食堂的英文是 canteen。在校园里，canteen 通常指学校食堂；若强调学生用餐和社交，也可用 dining hall，但 canteen 更常见于英式英语。
entries.definition: canteen 多指学校、工厂等机构内提供饭菜的固定场所。常见搭配：school canteen、staff canteen、eat in the canteen。注意与 restaurant 区分：canteen 更强调内部、平价、自助或半自助。

examples.en: I usually have lunch in the school canteen because it's cheap and close to the library.
examples.zh: 我通常在学校食堂吃午饭，因为那里便宜又离图书馆近。

examples.en: The canteen was so crowded after the roll call that we decided to skip class and grab a sandwich elsewhere.
examples.zh: 点名后食堂太挤了，我们决定逃课去别处买个三明治。

entries.shortAnswer: canteen 的中文意思是食堂，常指学校或机构内供餐的地方。与 restaurant 不同，canteen 通常更平价、更内部化，常见搭配有 school canteen、staff canteen。
entries.definition: canteen 核心义为食堂，指机构内设的用餐处。常见搭配：school canteen、canteen food、eat at the canteen。在英式英语中更常用；美式英语有时用 cafeteria。注意不要与“水壶”义混淆。

examples.en: I usually have lunch in the school canteen because it's cheap and close to the library.
examples.zh: 我通常在学校食堂吃午饭，因为那里便宜又离图书馆近。

examples.en: The canteen was so crowded after the roll call that we decided to skip class and grab a sandwich elsewhere.
examples.zh: 点名后食堂太挤了，我们决定逃课去别处买个三明治。

entries.shortAnswer: 补考的英文是 make-up exam（美式），英式拼写为 resit 或 retake。注意它指因挂科或缺考而额外安排的考试，不是普通期末考。
entries.definition: 「补考」指考试未通过或请假缺考后另行安排的考试，美式英语常用 make-up exam，英式多用 resit。搭配：take/sit a make-up exam（参加补考）、fail the make-up exam（补考没过）。

examples.en: I failed the final, so I have to take a make-up exam next week.
examples.zh: 我期末考挂了，所以下周得参加补考。

examples.en: She missed the midterm because of illness and was allowed to sit a make-up exam.
examples.zh: 她因病错过了期中考试，获准参加补考。

entries.shortAnswer: make-up exam 的中文意思是「补考」，指挂科或缺考后额外安排的考试。它与 resit 意思相近，但 make-up 更偏美式，且还可指补做的测验。
entries.definition: make-up exam 指因不及格、缺考或请假而额外安排的考试，多用于美式英语；英式英语常用 resit 或 retake。常见搭配：take a make-up exam、schedule a make-up exam、pass/fail the make-up exam。

examples.en: I failed the final, so I have to take a make-up exam next week.
examples.zh: 我期末考挂了，所以下周得参加补考。

examples.en: She missed the midterm because of illness and was allowed to sit a make-up exam.
examples.zh: 她因病错过了期中考试，获准参加补考。

entries.shortAnswer: 「点名」的英文是 roll call。老师上课前确认谁到了，就叫 roll call；它也是军队、宿舍等正式场合点名的常用说法。
entries.definition: roll call 指逐一念名字确认是否到场。常见搭配：take roll call（点名）、do roll call（点名）、miss roll call（没被点到/错点名）。注意：call someone's name 更强调“叫某人名字”，不一定是点名。

examples.en: The teacher takes roll call at the beginning of every class.
examples.zh: 老师每节课开始都会点名。

examples.en: If you miss roll call, you may be marked absent.
examples.zh: 如果你点名时不在，可能会被记为缺勤。

entries.shortAnswer: roll call 的中文意思是「点名」。它指按名单逐个确认是否在场，也可指点名的时间或仪式，常出现在学校、军队等场合。
entries.definition: roll call 是名词，指按名单点名确认到场。常见搭配：take roll call、do roll call、at roll call。与 attendance 不同：attendance 强调“出勤”本身，roll call 强调“点名”这个动作或时间。

examples.en: The teacher takes roll call at the beginning of every class.
examples.zh: 老师每节课开始都会点名。

examples.en: If you miss roll call, you may be marked absent.
examples.zh: 如果你点名时不在，可能会被记为缺勤。

entries.shortAnswer: 「图书馆」的英文就是 library，这里是借书、看书和安静自习的地方，可别和卖书的书店搞混了。
entries.definition: library 是可数名词，常见搭配有 school library、public library、go to the library、borrow books from the library，注意别拼成 libary。

examples.en: I usually go to the library after class to review my notes.
examples.zh: 我通常下课后去图书馆复习笔记。

examples.en: She borrowed three books from the school library for her history report.
examples.zh: 她从学校图书馆借了三本书来写历史报告。

entries.shortAnswer: library 的中文意思是「图书馆」，指可以借阅图书、阅读和自习的场所，和卖书的书店不一样。
entries.definition: library 是名词，常见搭配有 school library、public library、go to the library，也可指藏书或书房。

examples.en: I usually go to the library after class to review my notes.
examples.zh: 我通常下课后去图书馆复习笔记。

examples.en: She borrowed three books from the school library for her history report.
examples.zh: 她从学校图书馆借了三本书来写历史报告。

entries.shortAnswer: 「课表」的英文是 class schedule，指学校或课程安排的时间表。注意与 timetable 的区别：class schedule 更常用于美式英语，且常指个人选课后的时间安排。
entries.definition: class schedule 常与 check、change、fit into 等动词搭配，如 check my class schedule（查看课表）。在美式校园中，它多指学生个人的课程时间表；英式英语更常用 timetable。

examples.en: I checked my class schedule and realized I have three classes in a row on Monday.
examples.zh: 我查看了课表，发现周一连续有三节课。

examples.en: She changed her class schedule to avoid a conflict with her part-time job.
examples.zh: 她调整了课表，以避免和兼职工作冲突。

entries.shortAnswer: 「class schedule」的中文意思是「课表」，即学校课程的时间安排表。它和 timetable 意思相近，但 class schedule 更强调个人选课后的上课时间安排，常见于美式英语。
entries.definition: class schedule 指学生或教师个人课程的时间表，常见搭配有 check my class schedule、a busy class schedule。美式英语常用，英式英语则多说 timetable；注意不要与 syllabus（教学大纲）混淆。

examples.en: I checked my class schedule and realized I have three classes in a row on Monday.
examples.zh: 我查看了课表，发现周一连续有三节课。

examples.en: She changed her class schedule to avoid a conflict with her part-time job.
examples.zh: 她调整了课表，以避免和兼职工作冲突。

entries.shortAnswer: 「挂科」的英文是 fail an exam，也可说 flunk an exam，多用于考试或课程不及格。注意 fail 作不及物时也可直接说 fail the course，不必加 exam。
entries.definition: fail an exam 指某门考试没通过，口语里常用 flunk；若说挂了一门课，用 fail a course。补考是 make-up exam，重考是 retake。

examples.en: He was so afraid of failing an exam that he stayed up late studying every night.
examples.zh: 他特别怕挂科，所以每晚都熬夜学习。

examples.en: If you fail an exam, you usually have to take a make-up exam before the next term.
examples.zh: 如果挂科了，通常要在下学期前参加补考。

entries.shortAnswer: fail an exam 的中文意思是「挂科」，即考试未通过。它强调考试结果不合格，而 flunk 更口语，fail a course 则指整门课程不及格。
entries.definition: fail an exam 是中性偏正式说法，口语常用 flunk an exam；搭配有 fail a test、fail a course。注意 fail 后接考试或科目，不接分数。

examples.en: He was so afraid of failing an exam that he stayed up late studying every night.
examples.zh: 他特别怕挂科，所以每晚都熬夜学习。

examples.en: If you fail an exam, you usually have to take a make-up exam before the next term.
examples.zh: 如果挂科了，通常要在下学期前参加补考。

entries.shortAnswer: 奖学金英文是 scholarship，指奖励学业或科研优秀者的资助，与 grant（助学金）、loan（贷款）不同。
entries.definition: scholarship 常指学校或机构为奖励优秀学生提供的资助，常见搭配有 win/receive/apply for a scholarship。

examples.en: She worked hard to win a full scholarship to her dream university.
examples.zh: 她努力学习，赢得了梦想大学的全额奖学金。

examples.en: He applied for several scholarships to cover his tuition and living expenses.
examples.zh: 他申请了好几项奖学金来支付学费和生活费。

entries.shortAnswer: Scholarship 的中文是奖学金，指基于学业或才能发放的资助，通常无需偿还，与 grant 和 loan 不同。
entries.definition: Scholarship 作名词指奖学金，也指学术研究；常见搭配有 receive/win/apply for a scholarship。

examples.en: She worked hard to win a full scholarship to her dream university.
examples.zh: 她努力学习，赢得了梦想大学的全额奖学金。

examples.en: He applied for several scholarships to cover his tuition and living expenses.
examples.zh: 他申请了好几项奖学金来支付学费和生活费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「逃课」的英文是 skip class，指故意不去上课，口语中也说 play hooky。
entries.definition: skip class 搭配：skip a class 或 skip history，指逃某节课。名词为 class skipping。口语 play hooky 更俏皮；正式场合用 miss class，但未必是故意。

examples.en: He decided to skip class and go to the basketball game instead.
examples.zh: 他决定逃课去看篮球赛。

examples.en: If you skip class too often, you might fail the final exam.
examples.zh: 如果你逃课太多，期末考试可能会挂科。

entries.shortAnswer: 「skip class」的中文意思是「逃课」，指故意不去上课，口语中常说 play hooky。
entries.definition: skip class 是口语短语，意为故意缺课。搭配：skip a class 或 skip school。名词形式 class skipping。英式英语也常用 bunk off。

examples.en: He decided to skip class and go to the basketball game instead.
examples.zh: 他决定逃课去看篮球赛。

examples.en: If you skip class too often, you might fail the final exam.
examples.zh: 如果你逃课太多，期末考试可能会挂科。

entries.shortAnswer: 「志愿」在英文里常对应 college application，指大学申请时提交的志愿选择。
entries.definition: college application 指大学申请，包含填写志愿。中文“填志愿”也可说 list your college preferences。

examples.en: I need to finish my college application before the deadline next week.
examples.zh: 我得在下周截止日期前完成我的大学申请（志愿）。

examples.en: She listed her top three college applications, but only got into her second choice.
examples.zh: 她填了三个志愿，但只被第二志愿录取了。

entries.shortAnswer: College application 的中文意思是“志愿”，指大学申请中填写的志愿或申请本身。
entries.definition: college application 指大学入学申请，常搭配 submit 或 complete。中文“志愿”也可说 preferences。

examples.en: I need to finish my college application before the deadline next week.
examples.zh: 我得在下周截止日期前完成我的大学申请（志愿）。

examples.en: She listed her top three college applications, but only got into her second choice.
examples.zh: 她填了三个志愿，但只被第二志愿录取了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「成绩单」的英文是 report card。它指学校定期发给家长的学生成绩报告单；大学官方成绩单一般说 transcript 或 academic transcript。
entries.definition: report card 常用于中小学，记录各科成绩、评语和出勤，美式英语常用；大学申请或求职用的正式成绩单是 transcript（美式也常说 academic record）。Grade report 较少作名词指成绩单，grade 本身多指分数。

examples.en: My son brought home his report card yesterday, and he got an A in math.
examples.zh: 我儿子昨天把成绩单带回家了，他数学得了 A。

examples.en: She was afraid to show her parents the report card because she had failed two subjects.
examples.zh: 她不敢把成绩单给父母看，因为她有两门科目不及格。

entries.shortAnswer: report card 的中文意思是「成绩单」。它通常指学校发给家长的学生成绩报告单，而大学正式成绩单常用 transcript。
entries.definition: report card 是名词，指学校定期发给家长的成绩报告单，美式英语常用；英式英语有时说 school report。大学申请用的官方成绩单是 transcript，不要混用。

examples.en: My son brought home his report card yesterday, and he got an A in math.
examples.zh: 我儿子昨天把成绩单带回家了，他数学得了 A。

examples.en: She was afraid to show her parents the report card because she had failed two subjects.
examples.zh: 她不敢把成绩单给父母看，因为她有两门科目不及格。

entries.shortAnswer: 文具的英文是 stationery，不可数名词，指笔、本子、信封等书写用品总称，与 stationary（静止的）形近但不同。
entries.definition: 不可数名词，文具的统称，无复数，不能说 a stationery。常见搭配：stationery shop（文具店）、office stationery（办公文具）。具体物件用 pen、notebook 等。

examples.en: I need to buy some stationery for the new semester, such as notebooks, pens, and folders.
examples.zh: 我需要为新学期买些文具，比如笔记本、笔和文件夹。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to bring our own stationery to the exam, including pencils and erasers.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们考试时自带文具，包括铅笔和橡皮。

entries.shortAnswer: stationery 的中文意思是文具，指笔、本子、信封等书写用品的总称，不可数，与形近词 stationary（静止的）不同。
entries.definition: 不可数名词，文具的总称，包括笔、纸、信封、便签等。常见搭配：stationery store（文具店）、office stationery（办公文具）。问具体物品时用 pen、notebook 等可数名词。

examples.en: I need to buy some stationery for the new semester, such as notebooks, pens, and folders.
examples.zh: 我需要为新学期买些文具，比如笔记本、笔和文件夹。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to bring our own stationery to the exam, including pencils and erasers.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们考试时自带文具，包括铅笔和橡皮。

entries.shortAnswer: 录取通知书常说 admission letter，也可叫 acceptance letter 或 offer，是学校正式通知你被录取的文件。
entries.definition: admission letter 指大学录取通知书，正式用语；口语也常用 acceptance letter 或 offer。注意与 application（申请）和 enrollment（入学注册）区分。

examples.en: She was thrilled when she received her admission letter from the university.
examples.zh: 收到大学的录取通知书时，她激动不已。

examples.en: He checked the mailbox every day, hoping his admission letter would arrive soon.
examples.zh: 他每天查看邮箱，希望录取通知书能快点到。

entries.shortAnswer: admission letter 的中文意思是录取通知书，也可说 acceptance letter；它是学校正式通知你被录取的文件。
entries.definition: admission letter 或 acceptance letter 指录取通知书，为正式用语。常见搭配：receive an admission letter；注意与 application letter（申请信）区分。

examples.en: She was thrilled when she received her admission letter from the university.
examples.zh: 收到大学的录取通知书时，她激动不已。

examples.en: He checked the mailbox every day, hoping his admission letter would arrive soon.
examples.zh: 他每天查看邮箱，希望录取通知书能快点到。
